source: hand-written stand-in, not a model run: written in the style of the calls of 24 and 25 Nov 2026 to exercise this persona's checks; a --live --record run replaces it.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Hello Umesh garu, I am Varsha calling from Rytu Khata. Is now a good time to talk?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Please check if the Rytu Khata app is on your home screen. If it is not, go to rytukhata.com and press install. Tell me when it is done.

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay sir, now open the app and log in with your phone number. Tell me when you are in.

turns.speaker: caller
turns.text: Wait, how much does this app cost? Is my data safe?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: It is a very good app sir, many farmers use it. Have you logged in?

turns.speaker: agent
turns.text: Okay sir, now press My Farms and add your farm details. Tell me when it is done.
